title: Governance Production environment and provider-capability preflight

phases.objective: Bind Governance DB Production preflight to an explicit database-provider capability authority and the canonical Environment Authority without moving database credentials, grants, provider mutation, migration execution, or deployment authority into Spec 018.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Governance DB Production preflight before any credential readiness, principal provisioning, privilege probe, or governed migration lifecycle
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The preflight first requires the repository-defined Production database provider to support a dedicated second principal plus exact direct table grants, then requires a dedicated Governance DB identity and canonical Environment Authority with Production as both production branch and promotion target; unsupported provider capability fails with bounded no-secret evidence before credential readiness or database connection.
steps: Load the repository-defined Production database provider capability policy without reading secrets or connecting to a database.

Fail closed with GOVERNANCE_DB_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNSUPPORTED when the provider cannot represent the dedicated Governance writer contract, and with GOVERNANCE_DB_PROVIDER_CAPABILITY_UNRESOLVED when the policy is absent.
Only after provider support, resolve and validate the dedicated GOVERNANCE_DB_USER and GOVERNANCE_DB_PASSWORD configuration without falling back to the ordinary runtime DB identity.
Load Environment Authority through the Spec 018 resolver.
Return bounded preflight evidence only after all independent authority domains pass.
assertions: Database provider capability, Environment/branch authority, and database mutation identity are independent fail-closed concerns.
The current repository Production provider policy is explicitly unsupported for the dedicated Governance writer contract rather than being represented as missing credentials only.
Provider capability failure occurs before Governance credential readiness, Environment Authority loading, database connection, or SQL execution.
A caller cannot treat main as the Production authority for Governance DB operations.
Runtime DB_USER and DB_PASSWORD never satisfy Governance writer identity requirements.
The preflight output and errors contain no username or password values.
The preflight does not connect to MariaDB, execute SQL, apply a migration, mutate a provider, deploy, or restart runtime.
This integration composes with the Environment Authority foundation and does not move database-provider remediation into Spec 018.
